            if (self.previous_spy_close is not None and

                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma and

                quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0:
            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close

from AlgorithmImports import *


class SpecifiedStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aapl = self.add_equity("AAPL", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.ibm = self.add_equity("IBM", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.bac = self.add_equity("BAC", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aig = self.add_equity("AIG", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.sma(self.spy, 100, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.spy_sma_values = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.rsi_threshold = 70

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        if any(symbol not in data.bars or data.bars[symbol] is None for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data.bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.bars[self.aapl]

        self.spy_sma_values.add(float(self.spy_sma.current.value))
        self.aapl_closes.add(float(aapl_bar.close))

        if not self.spy_sma.is_ready or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready:
            return

        if not self.spy_sma_values.is_ready or not self.aapl_closes.is_ready:
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0:
            yesterday_sma = self.spy_sma_values[1]
            today_sma = self.spy_sma_values[0]

            if spy_bar.close >= yesterday_sma and spy_bar.close < today_sma:
                self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > self.rsi_threshold:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0:
            yesterday_sma = self.spy_sma_values[1]
            today_sma = self.spy_sma_values[0]

            if spy_bar.close <= yesterday_sma and spy_bar.close > today_sma:
                quantity = int((self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) / spy_bar.close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0:
            red_for_three_days = (
                self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1]
                and self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2]
                and self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
            )

            if red_for_three_days and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity
